Rational point tests and Simpson quadrature verify algebra and normalization, not the universal proof.

value.rationale: The extremal four-meridian torus is a natural object explicitly studied in the motivating primary paper. Merely counting cycles does not describe physical time. The lowest-degree anisotropic cofactor reveals an exact strict three-clock hierarchy and sharply distinguishes a single critical cycle from the three unaffected cycles, with an exact multiplier product and two sharp singular constants. These invariants organize the dynamics of the original, unrescaled flow and are more than a pointwise or renamed special case.
